networks.name: loose_change_agent
networks.description: I find forgotten subscriptions, price rises, double charges and bank fees in a bank statement. Load one on the page, add your AI key below, then ask me.
sample_queries: Load the sample statement and tell me what looks off.
Load the sample statement and add up what I spent eating out in September 2026.
Load the sample statement and list my regular charges with what each costs per year.
Load the sample statement, find the merchants you do not know and put them in the right categories.
Load the sample statement and save a report of what you find.
Cancel my Netflix subscription for me.

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only. This site calls no other site; other sites call it.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
